component.name: Duckfoot
component.summary: Edit photos and camera RAW files, on your own device

description.p: Duckfoot is a fast photo editor for ordinary photos and the RAW files of serious cameras. It draws every edit on the GPU, so sliders move in real time even on a full resolution photo, and never changes the original: edits are kept in a small file beside it.

ul.li: RAW files from Canon, Nikon, Sony, Fujifilm, Olympus, Panasonic, Pentax and more
Light, colour, curves, colour grading and a black-and-white mixer
Masks by brush, gradient, radial, or found: the subject or the sky
Spot healing, lens correction, noise reduction and film grain
Ratings, flags, labels, keywords and captions, and batch export

description.p: No account, no cloud, no tracking: photos never leave the device.
